root_cause.text: The error exit path in `csio_eh_lun_reset_handler` jumps to the label `fail` when `rn` is NULL, but `fail` invokes the macro `CSIO_INC_STATS(rn, ...)` which dereferences the null pointer `rn`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the `goto fail;` to `goto fail_ret;` when `rn` is NULL, adding a new label `fail_ret` after the macro call so that the macro is not executed for a NULL `rn`. The CVE description explicitly states that the error path dereferences the null pointer via `CSIO_INC_STATS`.
